T-3472: people walk like people: real pace, heel to toe, swinging arms, skirts

A gait layer (human-gait.js) over the baked walk: the phase advances with the
distance walked, the stance foot is planted and rolls heel, flat, ball; the swing
leg follows the normative hip/knee/ankle curves (WBDS, Fukuchi et al. 2018); the
pelvis rises over the stance leg and turns and tilts with the step. Speed and
stride come from each person's sex, age, height and dress (Oberg 1993, Bohannon &
Andrews 2011). The arms swing from the gait's phase with the elbow bending forward,
the hand loosely closed; the trunk counter-rotates and the head stays steady. A
woman's skirt swings off her legs (human-skirt.js) and never parts between them.
Reconstructed inside the measured ranges: liberty L-human-gait-3472.
